messages.author: 94ec915e8ce36448
messages.subject: Re: I can not install CODEX in latest R version(3.1.2)
parts:
Dear Song Li,

We have a development version of CODEX via Bioconductor--this is a bit hectic as it needs R devel but it will bump up to a stabilized version in late March once Bioconductor is updated to 3.1 version. Although, I have not personally installed CODEX in R 3.1.3, I think if you follow the guidelines below (second option), it should work. Please let me know.

Best,
Yuchao


Installation:
  • If you have R devel (and devel Version of Bioconductor), install directly from Bioconductor:
source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite("CODEX")
biocLite("WES.1KG.WUGSC") # toy data package
  • If you don't have R devel, download tarballs for both CODEX (CODEX_x.y.z.tar.gz) and the toy dataset (WES.1KG.WUGSC_x.y.z.tar.gz) -- under Package Archives:
# install depends: Rsamtools, GenomeInfoDb, and BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19
source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite("Rsamtools")
biocLite("BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19")
biocLite("GenomeInfoDb")

# install toy data package
install.packages('WES.1KG.WUGSC_x.y.z.tar.gz',repos=NULL,type='source')

# install CODEX
install.packages('CODEX_x.y.z.tar.gz',repos=NULL,type='source')

Mr./Ms. Zhang

I am a researcher in BGI. I have read your paper

CODEX: a normalization and copy number variation detection method for whole exome sequencing.

And I follow the link: http://master.bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/html/CODEX.html and want to install CODEX. But I cannot successfully install CODEX on my cluster. Even I use the latest version of R program.

The error message is “package 'CODEX' is not available (for R version 3.1.3 RC)”.

You really do a good job, I want use CODEX in my project. So how should I handle this problem. Please give me some advises.

Best,

Inna
